The fix I made was in cell 5, where the original code tried to use `labels[i]` directly as an index for `class_names`. However, since the dataset was loaded with `label_mode='categorical'`, the labels are one-hot encoded vectors (e.g., [0, 0, 1, 0, ...]) rather than simple integer indices.

I changed:
```python
plt.title(class_names[labels[i]])
```

To:
```python
plt.title(class_names[tf.argmax(labels[i]).numpy()])
```

This uses `tf.argmax()` to find the index of the maximum value in the one-hot encoded label vector (which gives us the actual class index), then converts it to a numpy integer using `.numpy()`. This allows the index to be used properly with `class_names`.
